# Van Gestel test catalog

A made-up route in the shape that `pnpm fetch:video-catalog` (ridrs_app `scripts/fetch-video-catalog.ts`) writes into `<pipeline>/vangestel/`: `index.json`, `<id>/package/` (the package without its video, ADR 0095), `<id>/thumbnail.jpg`, `<id>/overlay/`. No content of Fred Van Gestel; the pictures are text bytes. Used by `test/vangestel.test.mjs`.
